title: Insights - Capacity Planning

options.content: **Capacity planning.** A straight line is fitted to the daily values over the *History* you choose, and the tables show how soon each disk, database or server reaches the limits you set. It is a baseline, not a prediction: it knows nothing about planned projects, one-off clean-ups or seasonal peaks, and it needs at least 7 days of data per item. To see the projected lines in the chart, keep the time range reaching into the future (the default is the last 30 days to 90 days ahead).

panels.description: Used space per disk with its growth per day and the days until the Threshold is reached. Soonest first.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS server, i.InstanceName AS disk, CAST(p.DateTime AS date) AS dy, AVG(100.0 - p.AverageValue) AS used
  FROM Perf.vPerfDaily p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId AND r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName = '% Free Space'
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName NOT IN ('_Total', '')
    AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -${history}, CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS date))
  GROUP BY h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName, CAST(p.DateTime AS date)
),
x AS (
  SELECT server, disk, dy, used, CAST(DATEDIFF(day, '2000-01-01', dy) AS float) AS n FROM d
),
s AS (
  SELECT server, disk, COUNT(*) AS pts, SUM(n) AS sx, SUM(used) AS sy, SUM(n * used) AS sxy, SUM(n * n) AS sxx,
         MAX(dy) AS lastday, MIN(dy) AS firstday
  FROM x GROUP BY server, disk
),
f AS (
  SELECT s.server, s.disk, s.pts, s.lastday,
         CASE WHEN s.pts >= 2 AND (s.pts * s.sxx - s.sx * s.sx) <> 0 THEN (s.pts * s.sxy - s.sx * s.sy) / (s.pts * s.sxx - s.sx * s.sx) END AS slope,
         (SELECT TOP 1 x.used FROM x WHERE x.server = s.server AND x.disk = s.disk ORDER BY x.dy DESC) AS used_now
  FROM s
)
SELECT f.server AS Server, f.disk AS Disk,
       ROUND(f.used_now, 1) AS "Used % now",
       ROUND(f.slope, 3) AS "Growth (% points per day)",
       CASE WHEN f.pts < 7 THEN NULL WHEN f.used_now >= ${thr} THEN 0 WHEN f.slope > 0.0005 THEN ROUND((${thr} - f.used_now) / f.slope, 0) END AS "Days to threshold",
       CASE WHEN f.pts >= 7 AND f.used_now < ${thr} AND f.slope > 0.0005 THEN CONVERT(varchar(10), DATEADD(day, CAST((${thr} - f.used_now) / f.slope AS int), CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS date)), 23) END AS "Reaches threshold on",
       CASE WHEN f.pts < 7 THEN 'Not enough history'
            WHEN f.used_now >= ${thr} THEN 'Over threshold now'
            WHEN f.slope IS NULL OR f.slope <= 0.0005 THEN 'Not growing'
            WHEN (${thr} - f.used_now) / f.slope <= 30 THEN 'Within 30 days'
            WHEN (${thr} - f.used_now) / f.slope <= ${horizon} THEN 'Within horizon'
            ELSE 'Beyond horizon' END AS Status,
       f.pts AS "Days of data"
FROM f
ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.pts < 7 THEN 3 WHEN f.used_now >= ${thr} THEN 0 WHEN f.slope > 0.0005 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         CASE WHEN f.slope > 0.0005 THEN (${thr} - f.used_now) / f.slope END, f.server, f.disk

panels.title: Disks: when will they fill?

panels.description: Used % history, then a dashed projected line, against the threshold. At most 6 disks.

defaults.noValue: No disk is growing in the selected servers

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS server, i.InstanceName AS disk, CAST(p.DateTime AS date) AS dy, AVG(100.0 - p.AverageValue) AS used
  FROM Perf.vPerfDaily p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId AND r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName = '% Free Space'
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName NOT IN ('_Total', '')
    AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -${history}, CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS date))
  GROUP BY h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName, CAST(p.DateTime AS date)
),
x AS (SELECT server, disk, dy, used, CAST(DATEDIFF(day, '2000-01-01', dy) AS float) AS n FROM d),
s AS (
  SELECT server, disk, COUNT(*) AS pts, SUM(n) AS sx, SUM(used) AS sy, SUM(n * used) AS sxy, SUM(n * n) AS sxx, MAX(dy) AS lastday
  FROM x GROUP BY server, disk HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7
),
f AS (
  SELECT s.server, s.disk, s.lastday,
         (s.pts * s.sxy - s.sx * s.sy) / NULLIF(s.pts * s.sxx - s.sx * s.sx, 0) AS slope,
         (SELECT TOP 1 x.used FROM x WHERE x.server = s.server AND x.disk = s.disk ORDER BY x.dy DESC) AS used_now
  FROM s
),
pick AS (
  SELECT TOP 6 f.* FROM f WHERE f.slope > 0.0005 ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.used_now >= ${thr} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, (${thr} - f.used_now) / f.slope
)
SELECT y.time, y.metric, y.value FROM (
  SELECT CAST(x.dy AS datetime) AS time, p.server + ' ' + p.disk + ' used %' AS metric, ROUND(x.used, 2) AS value
  FROM x JOIN pick p ON p.server = x.server AND p.disk = x.disk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATEADD(day, n.number * 5, CAST(p.lastday AS datetime)), p.server + ' ' + p.disk + ' projected %',
         CASE WHEN p.used_now + p.slope * n.number * 5 > 100 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(p.used_now + p.slope * n.number * 5, 2) END
  FROM pick p JOIN master.dbo.spt_values n ON n.type = 'P' AND n.number <= ${horizon} / 5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATEADD(day, n.number * 5, CAST(DATEADD(day, -${history}, GETUTCDATE()) AS date)), 'Threshold %', ${thr}
  FROM master.dbo.spt_values n WHERE n.type = 'P' AND n.number <= (${history} + ${horizon}) / 5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pick)
) y
ORDER BY y.time

panels.title: The disks that will fill soonest, with projection

panels.description: p95 is the load the server stayed at or below for 95% of the hours. Constrained: p95 at or above High load. Over-provisioned: p95 at or below Low load. The trend is the change in percentage points per 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH hv AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS server, r.ObjectName AS obj, p.DateTime, p.AverageValue AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
    AND ((r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName = '% Processor Time') OR (r.ObjectName = 'Memory' AND r.CounterName = 'PercentMemoryUsed'))
    AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -${history}, GETUTCDATE())
),
pc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT server, obj,
         PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) OVER (PARTITION BY server, obj) AS p95,
         AVG(v) OVER (PARTITION BY server, obj) AS av, MAX(v) OVER (PARTITION BY server, obj) AS mx, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY server, obj) AS hrs
  FROM hv
),
dv AS (
  SELECT server, obj, CAST(DATEDIFF(day, '2000-01-01', CAST(DateTime AS date)) AS float) AS n, AVG(v) AS v
  FROM hv GROUP BY server, obj, CAST(DateTime AS date)
),
tr AS (
  SELECT server, obj, COUNT(*) AS pts, SUM(n) AS sx, SUM(v) AS sy, SUM(n * v) AS sxy, SUM(n * n) AS sxx FROM dv GROUP BY server, obj
),
cm AS (
  SELECT pc.server, pc.obj, pc.p95, pc.av, pc.mx, pc.hrs,
         CASE WHEN tr.pts >= 7 THEN 30.0 * (tr.pts * tr.sxy - tr.sx * tr.sy) / NULLIF(tr.pts * tr.sxx - tr.sx * tr.sx, 0) END AS trend30
  FROM pc JOIN tr ON tr.server = pc.server AND tr.obj = pc.obj
)
SELECT c.server AS Server,
       ROUND(c.av, 1) AS "CPU avg %", ROUND(c.p95, 1) AS "CPU p95 %", ROUND(c.mx, 1) AS "CPU max %", ROUND(c.trend30, 1) AS "CPU trend /30d",
       CASE WHEN c.hrs < 24 THEN 'Not enough data' WHEN c.p95 >= ${hi} THEN 'Constrained' WHEN c.p95 <= ${lo} THEN 'Over-provisioned' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS "CPU assessment",
       ROUND(m.av, 1) AS "Memory avg %", ROUND(m.p95, 1) AS "Memory p95 %", ROUND(m.mx, 1) AS "Memory max %", ROUND(m.trend30, 1) AS "Memory trend /30d",
       CASE WHEN m.hrs < 24 THEN 'Not enough data' WHEN m.p95 >= ${hi} THEN 'Constrained' WHEN m.p95 <= ${lo} THEN 'Over-provisioned' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS "Memory assessment"
FROM cm c
LEFT JOIN cm m ON m.server = c.server AND m.obj = 'Memory'
WHERE c.obj = 'Processor Information'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.p95 >= ${hi} OR m.p95 >= ${hi} THEN 0 WHEN c.p95 <= ${lo} AND m.p95 <= ${lo} THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, c.p95 DESC

panels.title: CPU and memory: constrained or over-provisioned?

panels.description: How fast each database grows and when the space already allocated to it is used up (SQL Server then grows the file).

matcher.options: Days until allocated space is used

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS server, e.DisplayName AS db, r.CounterName AS ctr, CAST(p.DateTime AS date) AS dy, AVG(p.AverageValue) AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfDaily p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId AND r.ObjectName = 'SQL Database' AND r.CounterName IN ('DB Allocated Space Used (MB)', 'DB Allocated Space Unused (MB)')
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.vManagedEntity c JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType ct ON ct.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = c.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND ct.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
                WHERE c.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND LEFT(c.DisplayName, CHARINDEX('.', c.DisplayName + '.') - 1) = LEFT(h.DisplayName, PATINDEX('%[.\]%', h.DisplayName + '.') - 1))
    AND p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -${history}, CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS date))
  GROUP BY h.DisplayName, e.DisplayName, r.CounterName, CAST(p.DateTime AS date)
),
u AS (SELECT server, db, dy, v, CAST(DATEDIFF(day, '2000-01-01', dy) AS float) AS n FROM d WHERE ctr = 'DB Allocated Space Used (MB)'),
s AS (SELECT server, db, COUNT(*) AS pts, SUM(n) AS sx, SUM(v) AS sy, SUM(n * v) AS sxy, SUM(n * n) AS sxx FROM u GROUP BY server, db),
g AS (
  SELECT s.server, s.db, s.pts, (s.pts * s.sxy - s.sx * s.sy) / NULLIF(s.pts * s.sxx - s.sx * s.sx, 0) AS mbday,
         (SELECT TOP 1 u.v FROM u WHERE u.server = s.server AND u.db = s.db ORDER BY u.dy DESC) AS used_now,
         (SELECT TOP 1 d2.v FROM d d2 WHERE d2.server = s.server AND d2.db = s.db AND d2.ctr = 'DB Allocated Space Unused (MB)' ORDER BY d2.dy DESC) AS unused_now
  FROM s
)
SELECT TOP 200 g.server AS Server, g.db AS "Database",
       ROUND(g.used_now / 1024.0, 2) AS "Used (GB)", ROUND(g.unused_now / 1024.0, 2) AS "Allocated, unused (GB)",
       ROUND(g.mbday, 2) AS "Growth (MB per day)",
       CASE WHEN g.pts >= 7 AND g.mbday > 0.01 AND g.unused_now IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(g.unused_now / g.mbday, 0) END AS "Days until allocated space is used",
       CASE WHEN g.pts < 7 THEN 'Not enough history' WHEN g.mbday IS NULL OR g.mbday <= 0.01 THEN 'Not growing' WHEN g.unused_now / g.mbday <= 30 THEN 'Within 30 days' WHEN g.unused_now / g.mbday <= ${horizon} THEN 'Within horizon' ELSE 'Beyond horizon' END AS Status
FROM g
ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.pts >= 7 AND g.mbday > 0.01 AND g.unused_now IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN g.pts >= 7 AND g.mbday > 0.01 THEN g.unused_now / g.mbday END, g.mbday DESC

panels.title: SQL Server databases: growth

panels.description: Size, use, maximum size and growth setting of each file. A file that cannot grow and is nearly full stops SCOM recording state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DB_NAME() AS "Database", f.name AS "File", CASE f.type WHEN 0 THEN 'Data' ELSE 'Log' END AS Type,
       CAST(f.size * 8 / 1024.0 AS decimal(12, 0)) AS "Size (MB)",
       CAST(FILEPROPERTY(f.name, 'SpaceUsed') * 8 / 1024.0 AS decimal(12, 0)) AS "Used (MB)",
       CAST(100.0 * FILEPROPERTY(f.name, 'SpaceUsed') / NULLIF(f.size, 0) AS decimal(5, 1)) AS "Used % of file",
       CASE WHEN f.max_size = -1 OR f.max_size >= 268435456 THEN 'Unlimited' ELSE CAST(CAST(f.max_size * 8 / 1024.0 AS decimal(12, 0)) AS varchar(20)) + ' MB' END AS "Maximum size",
       CASE WHEN f.growth = 0 THEN 'No growth' WHEN f.is_percent_growth = 1 THEN CAST(f.growth AS varchar(10)) + '%' ELSE CAST(f.growth * 8 / 1024 AS varchar(10)) + ' MB' END AS Growth,
       CASE WHEN f.growth = 0 AND 100.0 * FILEPROPERTY(f.name, 'SpaceUsed') / NULLIF(f.size, 0) >= 80 THEN 'Critical: cannot grow and nearly full'
            WHEN f.growth = 0 THEN 'Warning: cannot grow'
            WHEN f.max_size <> -1 AND f.max_size < 268435456 AND f.size * 1.0 / f.max_size >= 0.8 THEN 'Warning: nearly at its maximum size'
            ELSE 'OK' END AS Status
FROM sys.database_files f
ORDER BY f.type, f.name
